sources.text: For 25 years, XBOX has remained focused on building games players love, and our anniversary year has been a particularly strong example. From Gears of War: E-Day , Forza Horizon 6 , and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , to hugely anticipated games like Fable , players have more great games to play on XBOX than ever. Today, The Game Awards has announced this year’s list of nominees and titles across XBOX’s creative teams have earned eight nominations across multiple categories. Outside of gaming, Prime Video’s ‘Fallout’ has been nominated for Best Adaptation. Thank you to all of the teams that brought these great games to players. Voting is now open on The Game Awards’ official site – tune into The Game Awards on December 10 to see if your favorite games from 2026 take home an award. Our publishing partners also received nominations across a range of categories, with many games available to play today with Game Pass. 007 First Light and CONTROL Resonant are both nominated for Game of the Year and playable across devices with XBOX Play Anywhere. Game Pass subscribers can play nominees like Gears of War: E-Day , Forza Horizon 6 , No Man’s Sky , and more. See below for the full list of nominees playable on XBOX, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and remember you can vote for your favorites right now over at TheGameAwards.com . In the meantime, many of these titles will be available at their lowest prices yet with XBOX’s Black Friday sale, starting November 19 – find out more here . Congratulations to this year’s incredible nominees!

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches tomorrow, November 19
sources.text: The latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PlayStation 5 Thursday, November 19, available at PlayStation Store. The game is set in the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet. Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners. Meeting Lucia could be the best or worst thing to ever happen to him. Jason knows how he’d like it to turn out but right now, it’s hard to tell. Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk, and life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out but now more than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City. Instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands. Leonida is made up of six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga. Here’s a closer look at what makes each region unique. The glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city. Each neighborhood has something to offer, from the pastel art deco hotels and bright white sands of Ocean Beach, to the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba and the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market, out to the VC Port, the cruise ship capital of the world. We’re a long way from the ’80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America Life in this tropical archipelago isn’t flashy but it’s easy. Get your buzz on and pull up a deck chair but look out — you are right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America. You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse. The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves. Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won’t bring the tourists back, but there’s a new economy in this once-popular vacation spot. It’s fueled by malt liquor, painkillers, and truck stop energy drinks. In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme — whatever the cost. The Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs, while the local biker gang provides almost everything else. A national landmark up against the state’s northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails. In the lush surrounding backwoods, hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals live far from the prying eyes of the government. Spanning stations including Classic Rock, Modern Hip-Hop, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latin, ‘80s, Electronic, Blues, Ballads, Talk Radio, and much more, Grand Theft Auto VI features the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet. Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones.

sources.text: O mais novo título da série Grand Theft Auto nos leva ao estado de Leonida, até as ruas iluminadas de neon de Vice City e além. Jason e Lucia sempre souberam que as cartas não estavam a favor deles. Mas quando o que deveria ser um trabalho fácil dá errado, eles se encontram no lado mais escuro do lugar mais ensolarado da América, no meio de uma conspiração criminosa que cobre todo o estado de Leonida, forçados a depender um do outro mais do que nunca se quiserem sair vivos. Grand Theft Auto VI chega para PlayStation 5 quinta-feira, 19 de novembro, disponível na PlayStation Store. O jogo se passa no estado de Leonida, onde ficam as ruas banhadas de neon de Vice City e além, na maior e mais imersiva evolução da série até hoje. Jason cresceu rodeado de bandidos e vigaristas. Após um período no exército para tentar se livrar de sua adolescência perturbada, ele se encontra nos Keys fazendo o que faz melhor, trabalhando para traficantes de drogas locais. Conhecer Lucia pode ser a melhor ou a pior coisa que já aconteceu com ele. Jason sabe como gostaria que tudo terminasse, mas agora, é difícil prever. O pai de Lucia a ensinou a lutar desde que ela aprendeu a andar, e a vida tem vindo com tudo para cima dela desde então. Lutar por sua família a colocou na Penitenciária de Leonida. Sorte pura a livrou desta vez, mas agora mais do que qualquer coisa, Lucia deseja a vida boa com a qual sua mãe sonhava desde que moravam em Liberty City. Em vez de fantasias pela metade, Lucia está preparada para assumir o controle da situação. Leonida é composto de seis regiões: Vice City, as Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, e Mount Kalaga. Vamos conhecer o que torna cada região única. O glamour, o trabalho e a ganância da América capturados em uma única cidade. Cada bairro tem algo a oferecer, dos hóteis de art deco, cores pastel e areia branca de Ocean Beach, até as padarias de Little Cuba e as marcas falsificadas do mercadinho de Tisha-Wocka, até o VC Port, a capital mundial dos navios de cruzeiro. Estamos longe dos anos 80, mas Vice City ainda é a capital do sol e da diversão da América. A vida neste arquipélago tropical não é chamativa, mas é boa. Pegue uma cervejinha e puxe uma cadeira de praia, mas tome cuidado, você está à beira das águas mais belas e perigosas da América. Você nunca sabe o que está sob a superfície desta região primordial. Os jacarés podem ser a atração mais famosa, mas há predadores bem mais perigosos e descobertas mais estranhas entre o manguezal. Motéis baratos, atrações fechadas, e galerias de lojas vazias e abandonadas não vão trazer os turistas de volta, mas há uma nova economia neste local que já foi um ponto turístico. Agora mandam o as bebidas baratas, remédios contra a dor e bebidas energéticas. No coração de Leonida, a indústria Americana e os antigos valores ainda reinam supremos, seja qual for o custo. A refinaria de açúcar Allied Crystal providencia os empregos, e a gangue de motociclistas local providencia quase todo o resto. Um marco nacional na fronteira norte do estado, Mount Kalaga oferece as melhores trilhas off-road e pontos de pesca e caça. Nas florestas em torno, caipiras místicos e radicais paranóicos vivem longe dos olhos vigilantes do governo. Com estações de Rock Clássico, Hip-Hop Moderno, Pop, Metal, Dance, Latina, Anos 80, Electrônica, Blues, Baladas, Talk Radio, e muito mais, Grand Theft Auto VI possui a maior e mais variada seleção de rádios em um jogo até hoje. Além disso, pela primeira vez, Grand Theft Auto VI apresenta uma série de podcasts sob demanda para Jason e Lucia ouvirem além das rádios de Leonida, com ambos disponíveis para ouvir em veículos e a pé usando fones de ouvido e earbuds conectados aos seus smartphones.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 | Critical Consensus
sources.text: Critics praise the "richly drawn and compelling romance" of Jason and Lucia in GTA 6, delivering a record Metacritic score After a 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto 6 has been met with universal acclaim. Despite a lead-up marred by delays and leaks the hype has only grown, with over 17 million pre-orders generating more than $1.6 billion in revenue, according to recent data . Critics have spent weeks exploring Rockstar's Leonida, featuring the Bonnie-and-Clyde-inspired duo Jason and Lucia, leading to a Metacritic score of 99 . Backed by over 100 reviews, the title is currently listed as the platform's best game of all time , above the original N64 release of The Legend of Zelda: The Ocarina of Time. In the words of The Guardian 's Keza MacDonald: "Rockstar has created the most extraordinarily, indulgently detailed virtual world that we have seen yet." "Leonida is so lifelike that at times it beggars belief, so vast that it feels overwhelming [...] and contains so many potential experiences that it's hard to know where to start." IGN 's Luke Reilly emphasised that the wait for GTA 6 was reflected in the detail Rockstar has poured into its world. "This is a world that feels more lived-in and real than anything I've ever played, and it's one you can interact with at a level never seen before in the series," he said. "Rockstar has truly pushed the boat out.” The game's level of detail raised concerns about performance, particularly its 30fps cap on all consoles , including the PlayStation 5 Pro. However, Reilly found that this limitation did not diminish the experience. "What matters to me is that it looks absolutely incredible and runs smoothly and reliably on a standard PS5. I find all the brilliant visual flourishes far more important, from the concentric rings of ripples on water due to helicopter rotor downwash, to the almost imperceptible line of sweat that appears on Lucia's forehead after a brisk jog, or the buckling of the fabric on a shirt as torsos twist, to the temporary dents on a punching bag as you strike it." "If a sufficiently stable and properly paced 30fps is the route to GTA 6 looking and functioning the way it does, bug-free, then I have no complaints." GTA 6's immersion extends to daily routines that improve stats like health and stamina, or managing car fuel levels. As Game Informer 's Matt Miller observed, these activities "add pacing and counterpoint to the explosive march of major missions, narrative threads, and set-piece encounters that drive the game forward." These everyday moments are initially character-specific, as The New York Times' Yussef Cole noted. "Jason can opt to fix up his run-down bachelor pad in preparation for Lucia's imminent release. There are numerous tasks around the house, like putting up drywall, painting and fixing the roof, that take up the player's time and the character's in-game resources, but they aim toward a productive and satisfying goal: a better relationship." That's not to say GTA 6 isn't like past games, where violence is encouraged and chaos is one petty crime away. Miller emphasised that these moments do not detract from the "meticulously choreographed" set pieces, which "run the gamut from amusing shenanigans at a strip club to intense chases and escapes fueled by raging gunfights and explosions. Many of the best moments leverage an expert sense of musical accompaniment, weaving a slick original score alongside one of the most impressive and wide-ranging licensed soundtracks ever heard in a video game – often to surprisingly emotional effect." Critics agreed that GTA 6 offers unexpected emotional depth, thanks to nuance in both the representation of the lead characters and the player's ability to control them. IGN's Reilly described Jason and Lucia as "unlike any leads that have come before them in the series," whose priorities are each other and escaping the criminal life they find themselves increasingly entrenched in. "They're not angels, and it is invariably their recklessness as small-time crooks that puts them in the wrong place at the wrong time, but the overall sliminess of their far more powerful antagonists does make the couple easy to root for throughout their story,"he wrote. The New York Times' Cole agreed, adding that the emphasis on the duo's relationship "reflects a maturation of a series that has generally only told stories about men solipsistically chasing after their own success." He continued: "Choosing romance is the easy part, thanks to the chemistry and human characterisation of the two leads. Lucia and Jason's relationship builds on itself and becomes a constant, supportive presence. It gets reflected in the story missions too, as your characters make scripted choices that reflect how you behaved toward each other in the idle moments in between." Game Informer's Miller described Jason and Lucia's relationship as "elevating the game to new heights, lending this instalment a heart, tension, and emotional core missing from prior entries." "This is, without a doubt, video gaming's most richly drawn and compelling romance, featuring two leads who are immediately relatable and compelling to watch. Player actions dictate the strength of their bond, deepening the sense of engagement. Like the best crime fiction, you're left surprised by how much you cheer for two people who regularly commit terrible acts." The Guardian's MacDonald "found it impossible not to care" for the couple over time. "They are our avatars in GTA 6's world, but they are not blank stand-ins for the player: you decide their actions but not their personalities. They feel like real people rather than puppets dancing to your whim [...] When the story gave me opportunities to decide what would happen next, what came to mind for me was what they would do, not what I would do." sources.title: Newzoo analyst expects Grand Theft Auto to turn around a rough year for console gaming: 'without GTA 6 the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026'
sources.text: Consoles cost more than ever, and even if you can afford to buy one you don't have as much left over to buy games for it as you used to. That's made 2026 an underwhelming year for console gaming sales, but according to the latest forecast from videogame market analysts Newzoo , the imminent launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 will turn that around. "As we explored in the Global Games Market Report 2026," said Newzoo's director of market intelligence, Emmanuel Rosier, "without GTA VI the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026. Instead, the game's launch is expected to generate billions of dollars in revenue and give console spending a significant boost." Rosier is the analyst who, back in August, was skeptical about the idea of BioWare surviving long enough to make another Mass Effect game . I wish he'd been wrong about that, but it turned out he was right on the money with that prediction. "Western console has been losing ground," he went on to say. "Its share of global games revenue fell from 21.5% in 2015 to 17.1% in 2025, and its revenue has been broadly flat since 2021. Console adoption shows the same pattern. In Western markets, the console player base has been flat since 2022. Most people who want to play on console already do." Newzoo's prediction is that GTA 6 "will lift console full-game spending by 17.5% this year". But that's just the start of the story. "So while GTA VI is undoubtedly one of the most important releases of the decade," Rosier says, "its initial impact will be concentrated in Western console. That’s still a big market, which we forecast will be worth $36.3 billion in 2026, but it's only part of the industry. The longer-term global story will depend on what happens next, particularly on PC and online." Though tradition has plenty of people expecting a delay of roughly a year and a half between GTA 6's console and PC releases, general console malaise and the value of GTA Online—likely to be bigger on PC, and perhaps launch alongside the PC port—is a reason to think maybe the wait won't be so long. A recent GamesBeat report claims it'll be out in early 2027. "PC is far bigger than console in several major markets, including China," Rosier says, "and a PC release could expose the game to a much broader international audience. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. "The online mode is another key unknown. Depending on how it's positioned and monetized, it could significantly expand the game's audience. If Rockstar adopts a model that lowers barriers to entry, the long-term opportunity outside the traditional Western console audience could be much larger than it appears today." GTA Online was a huge part of GTA 5 's long-tail success. While Newzoo's data says at least 37% of players who preordered GTA 6 have spent money on GTA Online, only 15% did so in the last 12 months. It's in need of a refresh, and though Rockstar haven't confirmed anything, Twitch's CEO also says GTA 6's multiplayer component will be out in 2027 . sources.title: "We'd love to have you" - New Zealand's tourist board gives a nod to those hopping timezones to play Grand Theft Auto 6 early
sources.text: New Zealand's tourism board has taken advantage of all the excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch, as hordes of players who've changed their Xbox timezones to that of the world's second best rugby team (sorry) to jump into the game early. "One perk of seeing the sun first? Getting GTA 6 first too," reads a post on the New Zealand tourist board's Instagram account: PureNewZealand. "We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we'd love to have you." The post also includes a video of folks looking at all the natural beauty of New Zealand, presumably before they all look themselves indoors to play the video game, alongside the caption: "life, because we're getting GTA 6 first." For those unaware, Xbox owners have been swapping their console time zones for years to New Zealand in order to take advantage of the region's access to games before anywhere else in the world. When games have, let's say, a worldwide release time of midnight across all nations, those living in New Zealand are able to jump in first as a result. Microsoft has for years been happy to let this practice continue on its platform, and as such a sort of cultural norm about hopping on a digital plane for a game's release has been established. If you want guidance, we have a guide on how to pull off the GTA 6 New Zealand trick yourself which can walk you through it. If you aren't keen on doing so for whatever reason, you can find a breakdown of all the global launch times for GTA 6 too . If you want one final run through on what to expect from Rockstar's big release last minute, our Everything We Know about Grand Theft Auto 6 page should set you right for good measure.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 review
sources.text: My best attempt at summing up Grand Theft Auto 6 came from a conversation with a friend about something else entirely. This friend was telling me about a theory they'd recently heard, and half agreed with, that just so happened to layer over this game perfectly. Americans, they said, paraphrasing, have found a new 'third place': the car. I'm slightly skeptical of the obsession with third places these days - love the concept; less convinced that societal bonds are collapsing because today's men aren't spending enough time at their barber's. But here it felt just right: GTA 6 is, of course, a game both about America and about the personal vehicle. The clue's in the name. And as you play GTA 6, you realise, over and over, that the car is where so much of this game happens. It's where you take calls that lead to missions or story developments; where you pick up, hang out with, and chat to your partner; where you race away from police, gangs, wild animals and weirdos. Where you do much of your discovery of this properly, disorientatingly, astoundingly big and detailed world. Where you'll be when you find the most 'emergent events'. And, more than it's ever been before, the car is now an essential partner in itself; a place to stow weapons, disguises, and stolen goods - a companion it feels almost impossible to do without. I could go on about this. GTA 6 is a game of perpetual motion, as protagonists Jason and Lucia do their best to outrun a world that so often feels a step ahead - and which often culminates in some of the most exhilarating, astonishing chase sequences ever built in a video game. GTA 5 , its Los Santos-set predecessor, was aware enough of the importance of the car to name an in-game canyon after Reyner Banham, the British architectural critic who described Los Angeles' freeway system, one of the city's "four ecologies", as "Autopia". So yes: the car is the third place, in modern America and in GTA 6. The place of self-actualisation between work and home - two points that, for GTA 6's protagonists in particular, seem to always be in a state of flux. Maybe the car's their true home. For the longest time I really thought that idea summed up GTA 6 quite nicely. Until I didn't. Reducing GTA 6 to just the car, I realised, looking at it through only that one lens, forces you to be too narrow. You miss too much of it. What about the romance? The sensuality? The people and the natural world? And so what I've come to settle on instead - and honestly I expect this to change many more times over the coming days and weeks too, as even more of this horizonless game rolls back to reveal itself - is that GTA 6 just doesn't have a single thread to pull on. No one thing that, when properly grasped, suddenly draws it into a manageable shape. I've no doubt we'll all try. People have, for whatever reason, always reached for the most reductive ideas when they talk about Grand Theft Auto in particular. Maybe it's a natural response to something too big and unwieldy to instantly get your head around: to seize the first acceptable idea and declare it just 'x' . To admit something is too complex for you to immediately summarise is far less comfortable than simply dismissing it on the spot. Whatever it is, GTA 6 isn't just anything. For one, every thing it is also seems to have an opposite. It's vast - incomprehensibly vast - but also overloaded with miniscule detail. It's about big ideas, themes, places - America, society, love - and also about individuals. It's ridiculous and puerile, and also sometimes mature. Tender and violent. Deep and shallow. Novel and, in places, surprisingly familiar. It's both a big adventure playground of video game activities and a focused story of suffocating intensity. Whatever foible might arise, the game presents you with a ready-made answer - often quite literally: you can turn off notifications about your relationship status in the menu if you just want to ignore that part. You can switch to the old controls (GTA 6 has seen a bit of a control overhaul), from the first screen you're shown. Or simply tear off in the opposite direction to whatever it is that dissatisfies you and do something else. If there's an idea to reduce this game to, then, the best I can manage is this: maybe Grand Theft Auto 6 is a game designed to be irreducible. None of that is to say it's perfect. It's easy to stand in front of something like this and just bask in the awe of it, forgetting to stop a moment and step back. The awe is all part of the point, of course, and GTA 6 is nothing if not truly awesome, but there are also nits to pick. But then you step back again and they tend to fade away. GTA 6 will not be for everyone. But no game has made a better attempt at being everything. GTA 6's story begins with Jason and Lucia. Discussing it beyond that is, frankly, almost impossible to do with any kind of substance without also spoiling it. For all the precipitous leaks, Rockstar has kept its story's two most essential moments - its beginning and its end - entirely secret, and without those two moments we're only really left with euphemisms. Jason and Lucia are on the run, after a seemingly simple fetch quest goes awry. Who they're running from, or why they're being chased quite so hard, remains agonisingly beyond their field of view. But what is clear, right from the off, is exactly why they're so determined to escape. And amongst all this Rockstar has achieved something kind of momentous, when it comes to Grand Theft Auto: we've got real and very human stakes. What else can be said? Well, let's go back to Rockstar's decision to begin so explicitly with Jason and Lucia. This is a story about a relationship. You can nurture or neglect it, but fundamentally that relationship - however strong - is at the heart of things. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI does something impossible — it lives up to the hype
sources.text: Thirteen years later, Rockstar has crafted a worthy successor to GTA V and the new standard-bearer for open-world games. How do you follow a game like Grand Theft Auto V ? Thirteen years ago, Rockstar’s crime-fueled epic went on to redefine what an open-world game could be and became an enormous success, selling more than 230 million copies across three generations of game consoles. It sits just behind Tetris and Minecraft on the list of the best-selling games of all time, and its lucrative online mode has helped it remain popular for well over a decade. That level of success has allowed Rockstar to take its time with a sequel, which has further increased the hype around the next GTA . A series of major leaks and delays only exacerbated this. At a time when much of the video game industry is struggling , the next edition of GTA stands alone , a cultural moment so big ( almost ) everybody has been forced to get out of the way . The buildup to Grand Theft Auto VI ’s launch is unlike anything the game industry has ever seen. Even more remarkable? The game was actually worth the wait. At this point I’ve spent nearly 80 hours in Leonida, GTA VI ’s fictional take on Florida. And what I’ve experienced is a game that combines the wide-open freedom offered in GTA V with the remarkable level of immersion from the studio’s 2018 release Red Dead Redemption 2 , while also improving on both qualities. At the same time, it’s also the most mature GTA game Rockstar has ever made, merging the criminal antics and absurdist humor the series is known for with a love story that gives you new ways to interact with the world and new reasons for wanting to push forward. This is the GTA game the studio has been building toward for its entire existence. Let’s start with that new premise. GTA V introduced the idea of multiple protagonists to the series, and VI takes that concept in a different direction. It’s a Bonnie and Clyde-inspired story about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two small-time criminals who meet while, of course, stealing a car. It’s the most GTA -possible meet-cute. The idea is that you can play as both characters individually and also build their relationship over the course of the game. Things start out relatively slow. At the outset, Lucia is in prison, and you play solely as Jason, getting things ready for when she gets out. You can fix up your ramshackle house — that involves actually nailing down new stairs and rolling out paint on the walls — and also start building up a nest egg through means that are not exactly legal. Jason and Lucia’s relationship grows naturally over the course of the game, but it’s also a slow buildup to becoming the inseparable pair they were by the end of my playthrough. GTA VI approaches most of the experience with confident and deliberate pacing. Even when you control them individually, the characters are often together, either just hanging out or partnering for a crime. And being able to play as both is one of the game’s standout features. But I didn’t get to that point in the game until almost 17 hours in. Before that, you play as both leads mostly solo, learning who they are as people, before you’re given free rein to switch between the two. What’s great about the premise is how seamlessly it fits with what you’re actually doing in the game. There’s some bigger-picture stuff that I won’t spoil, but generally speaking, the main goal in GTA VI is to make a lot of money so that Jason and Lucia can get out of the criminal life for good and retire somewhere comfortably. And outside of the big story missions, you’re largely free to choose how you go about that. You can rob jewelry stores, steal cars, raid drug dens, or even search for hidden treasure at the bottom of the sea. Over the course of the game you’ll also meet different criminals who serve as fences, so you can sell them whatever you’ve got to build up your savings account. sources.text: More than a decade after Grand Theft Auto V was first released, its sequel is finally launching. On November 19th, GTA VI will be available on both the PS5 and Xbox Series X / S, and it’s quite possibly the most anticipated video game launch of all time . Part of this has to do with the success of its predecessor, as GTA V sold more than 230 million copies over the last 13 years. Some of it has to do with the sheer length of time between releases, a period that was plagued by leaks and a handful of delays that made the wait even harder for fans. But GTA VI is now a real thing you can play, and you can also keep track of all of the important post-launch information right here. That includes our own review and interviews with the development team, as well as news on just how the game ends up resonating with players. We finally have more details about GTA VI’s graphics, including that it’s upscaling 1440p to 4K on base PS5 and Xbox Series X, but PSSR2 on the PS5 Pro. AMD’s FSR Upscaling 4 is used to scale the resolution from 720p to 1080p on Series S. Digital Foundry explains how input lag factored into those choices, as well as the differences between platforms , how well it holds to the target 30fps framerate, plus the impact of VRR. With Grand Theft Auto VI set to finally launch tomorrow, November 19th, our long-awaited return to Vice City is nearly here. But after all this time, some of the gear you’ve used in San Andreas might feel out of place on the glamorous streets of Leonidas County. Luckily for you, we’ve gathered a few of our favorite Xbox and PlayStation 5 accessories to help your long gaming sessions run as smoothly as possible. The 8BitDo Ultimate 3E — an upgraded pick for Xbox Series X and Series S consoles — is a very capable, comfortable controller with elite-level features, including a high polling rate and adjustable triggers. It’s on the expensive side at $149.99, but the customization and clean execution justify the cost. Read our review . It took 13 years , a reported 10-figure budget, and the weight of the world’s expectations, but Grand Theft Auto VI is here. And it’s fantastic . The Verge ’s Andrew Webster takes a break from the game to tell us all about life in Vice City, and why GTA VI ’s approach to coffee tells us everything we need to know. Lost in the excitement of GTA VI finally launching is the fact that Rockstar employees are in the process of voting on whether or not to unionize. Developer Nestor Uriarte explains the importance of the moment in an essay in The Guardian : Winning union recognition would be a huge step forward in securing a meaningful say over our conditions at Rockstar, but its significance would reach far beyond that. As one of the biggest and most influential game studios in the world, what happens here could open the door for other workers across the UK to imagine an alternative future for the industry – one in which workers’ voices are taken into account more. Now that reviews have dropped for the game, it has skyrocketed to the top of Metacritic’s highest-rated list , surpassing Ocarina of Time (the original, not the remake ). Of course, this could change as more reviews trickle in, but for now it’s safe to say that GTA VI was worth the long wait. Grand Theft Auto VI isn’t just the biggest GTA game to date; it’s also the most romantic. Though the series is well known for its sordid assortment of criminal leads, GTA VI switches things up by starring a pair of thieves who also happen to fall in love after meeting while stealing a car. It’s still an open-world action game full of chaos and mayhem. But many players will also be attempting to nurture the budding relationship in between heists. The sprawling game is designed to support both audiences. “It’s a risk,” explains Rob Nelson, producer on GTA VI and co-studio head at developer Rockstar North. “It’s a real change for Grand Theft Auto . You can still play it the old way, you can reject all of this stuff. Thirteen years ago, Rockstar’s crime-fueled epic went on to redefine what an open-world game could be and became an enormous success, selling more than 230 million copies across three generations of game consoles. It sits just behind Tetris and Minecraft on the list of the best-selling games of all time, and its lucrative online mode has helped it remain popular for well over a decade. That level of success has allowed Rockstar to take its time with a sequel, which has further increased the hype around the next GTA . A series of major leaks and delays only exacerbated this. At a time when much of the video game industry is struggling , the next edition of GTA stands alone , a cultural moment so big ( almost ) everybody has been forced to get out of the way . The buildup to Grand Theft Auto VI ’s launch is unlike anything the game industry has ever seen. Sony has confirmed the 1.267GB download is mandatory to play the new Grand Theft Auto when it launches at midnight tonight. As with most PlayStation firmware patches, we don’t know what it does though, beyond “some security fixes to the system software.” Rockstar hasn’t publicly said who is playing the two leads in GTA VI , but The Game Awards’ nominee video says that Manni L. Perez has been nominated for Best Performance for her work in the game. GTA VI earned eight nominations , the most of any title, including one for Game of the Year . I get the impression that a year from now, five years, ten years, there will still be people rushing to subreddits and forums (if we still have those) to ask if others have seen this or that little detail Rockstar tucked into some obscure corner of its humungous world. "Grand Theft Auto VI is Rockstar’s best game", writes Dan Ryckert. "In the thirteen years between entries of one of the biggest franchises in entertainment, fans’ expectations grew to a level that felt unrealistic. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Rockstar Games Tips Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. The long wait was totally worth it. It is one of the best games I’ve played in many years and easily the best Grand Theft Auto game ever made. It is also a big, complicated, and deep game, with so much to do and see. Without spoiling anything, there are some incredibly big surprises and really memorable moments buried in this game. I highly recommend that people avoid watching too many videos about GTA 6 ahead of playing it to avoid ruining one particular late-game moment that might be one of my favorite video game surprises in years. Before you rush out the door to do some missions or rob a liquor store, take a moment to grab a bite and a drink. These items will buff your health, stamina, and focus meter, letting you take more damage, run longer, and slow down time more during combat. And hey, don’t assume that just because you’re drinking a soda or eating a hot dog, you have to stop moving or shooting. In GTA 6 , you can move, shoot, run, hold hands, and even drive while holding and eating food. Finally, you can crack a cold one while shooting a rifle. Around the map, you’ll encounter dogs and cats. If you hold the left trigger, you can zoom in on them and then praise and pet them. And you should do this, not just because dogs and cats are great, but also because it buffs your focus and rewards you with some good behavior points toward your criminal profile. In GTA 6 , you can store guns and clothes in your personal car’s trunk. And you should do this, as changing clothes is a great and fast way to lose the attention of the police. You can manage your clothing, create new custom outfits, and store clothes in your trunk at any clothing store with a changing room, so don’t feel like you have to head back home to change your outfits around or remove stuff from your trunk. Just find a store. Also, Rockstar lets you rename your custom outfits using a list of pre-existing words, like clubbing, hunting, or everyday. The world of Leonida is packed with random events and moments that you can encounter while just walking around. These can be as simple as a drug deal going bad, or as complex as someone who needs help finding their missing spouse after a night partying. Often these events will be signaled to the player via shouting or other loud noises. If you hear something like that, click the left and right sticks to activate focus mode and find the source of the commotion, and then go investigate it. sources.text: With Grand Theft Auto 6 âs world being as big as it is and current consoles being six years old, thereâs naturally a bit of worry about how the game performs on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Our reviewer played the game on a PS5 Pro, considered to be the most powerful console on the market right now, and said that while it runs at 30 frames-per-second most of the time, there were still some noticeable frame drops in crowded areas. But if you havenât bought a PS5 Pro, what can you expect from GTA 6 âs performance? Well, the folks over at Digital Foundry have done what they do best and created some lengthy technical breakdowns of the game, including stress testing it in explosive situations. According to their video, the PS5 Pro tends to hold a pretty solid 30fps, unless you go around making a mess by blowing up a lot of cars at once; in those moments Digital Foundry saw the game dip to around 24fps at its lowest. The base PS5, however, seems to struggle to maintain 30fps in the best of cases, and if you decide to cause a lot of on-screen destruction, those dips are actually sustained until you leave an area.Â On the Xbox side, the Xbox Series X seems to share the same relative stability as the PS5 Pro, with the same frame drops during car chases, crowded scenes, or firefights when things get busier on screen. The big question is how the Xbox Series S, which was originally released in 2020 as a cheaper, lower-powered alternative to the bougie, more expensive consoles of the year, handles GTA 6 . According to Digital Foundry , there are some details that are less prevalent or rendered with lower-res textures, and the resolution is lower, coming in at 720p compared to the 1440p of Series X. The DF video has a number of comparison shots demonstrating how a lot of small details have been downgraded on Series S, but the real difference is that the framerate is, unsurprisingly, struggling the most on the less powerful Xbox. Digital Foundry reports that while 30fps is the target, even the most “typical” play can affect framerate, with standard combat encounters and car chases dropping it to around 25 and the more demanding carnage bringing it down to 20. There’s even a few seconds in the video where it gets down to 18 and 19fps during an explosive shootout. Ultimately, if youâre hoping for the smoothest possible experience, the PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X are the unsurprising winners here. A PC version of the game is rumored to launch sometime next year , and I imagine thatâs where folks with high-end builds are going to be able to get smoother, 60fps framerates as Rockstar apparently has no plans to add a Performance Mode to GTA6 on consoles. If youâre running a Series S, maybe try not to cause too much mayhem along the way for best results.Â Though the Xbox Series S provided a more affordable way for people to jump into the next generation of gaming consoles in 2020, as time has gone on and games have gotten more demanding on the hardware, developers have expressed frustration with having to make their games compatible with the device. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is "the smoothest GTA game in history" despite 30fps, analysis finds
sources.text: GTA 6's frame rate isn't flawless, but it's substantially better than how its predecessors launched GTA 6 is finally here – well, depending on your time zone, anyway. In any case, it's a real video game that people are actually playing, which means it's time to discuss the game's most important aspect: its resolution and frame rate. According to a new tech analysis, Rockstar has managed to coax solid performance out of the current-gen consoles even while pursuing nigh-unprecedented levels of fidelity. "GTA 6 is a 30 frames per second game, but that also kind of makes it the smoothest GTA game in history, at least at launch," as tech analyst John Linneman explains in a new Digital Foundry video . "Every previous entry ran significantly worse on the original target hardware. Whether that trade-off is worthwhile, however, is entirely up to the individual. But as things stand, I'm not convinced that they could have achieved 60 frames per second in a game of this scope on this class of hardware." It's now trivial to play previous GTA games at 60fps or above, but each previous 3D entry targeted 30fps on its original platforms and regularly dipped below that target. GTA 6's hold on its 30fps target is much stronger. On base PS5 and Xbox Series X (which Digital Foundry covered in a separate analysis ), the game will dip below 30fps at times when, say, screaming down the road at speed, but those dips are "very minor." If you really try to break the game by heading into a busy intersection with a grenade launcher and causing chaos, you can cause the frame rate to take a more sustained dive, but you'll get a solid experience in the course of normal play. While you can get some dips with the kind of chaos on PS5 Pro, the whole experience seems to be even smoother on Sony 's high-end hardware. "I spent most of my time on the PS5 Pro, which is the best way to play this game by far," Linneman says. "You basically get a near-flawless 30fps update. The frame pacing is perfect, cutscenes consistent and fluid, unlike older Rockstar titles, and everything moves without hiccups or stutters." Yes, that does also mean Rockstar's finally fixed the cutscene judder that's plagued its games since GTA 4 . The miracles continue. Well, there is one exception, as you probably shouldn't expect any miracles on Xbox Series S. Microsoft 's lower-end machine retains most of the graphical features of its more fully-featured counterparts, which I suppose is miraculous in its own way, but its frame rate brings us back to the peak of Xbox 360 gaming, with sustained drops into the 20fps range whenever there's real action on-screen. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more While Rockstar's decision to go 30fps with GTA 6 has been controversial , Linneman is "more willing to forgive it due to just how far it's pushing the visuals." He adds, "it feels like tasting the future." Check out our full GTA 6 review if you're interested in, you know, the actual game rather than the frame rates. 4. sources.text: We’ve known for quite a while that we’ll be able to consume drugs in Grand Theft Auto 6. It was one of the elements we learned about that firmly established it as one of the most mature GTA games ever made. It mirrors Red Dead in terms of live consumption, but from what we know, you can consume things like cocaine at the press of a button. But how exactly do you do that? How do you take drugs in GTA 6? And how do you get more drugs when you’ve run out? In this guide, we’ll explain how it all works and answer those questions. If you want to find your fix in GTA 6, you’ll be happy to know it’s not so hard to get your hands on some drugs. Like many other things, you’ll find narcotics on downed enemies. For instance, you might eliminate someone to find a baggie of cocaine in their pocket. This is a relatively simple way to find drugs in GTA 6. Alternatively, you might stumble upon some pills or powder when digging through a mission location, just like you might find healing items, ammunition, or food. That’s not all, though. This game is bursting with dynamic events, and one that we’ve seen saw a plane crash nearby while we were exploring. On board was a stash of cocaine packages, and we racked up around $10,000 after taking and selling the stash to Brian, your ‘boss’, whom you meet very early in the game. These events are very random and unpredictable, just to keep the world as emergent as possible, so you might see something immediately, or you might never see it. That’s the beauty of this game. If we’re talking about less hard substances, you can buy cigarettes and alcohol at liquor, convenience, and grocery stores. sources.title: GTA 6 Finally Explains Why You Can Hear The Police Radio Chatter
sources.text: If you’ve played any of the mainline Grand Theft Auto games, you’ve likely committed a crime and heard a police radio communication reporting your naughty behavior. It’s been a part of the series since the first game. And yet, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the first game in the series to actually explain how your character can hear this police chatter. Early on in Grand Theft Auto 6 , Jason’s hacker friend and stoner buddy Cal does the character a solid. He grabs his phone and installs a custom, homebrew police radio scanner program. From then on, Jason can hear the police reporting on his actions, crimes, and location, as was the case in ( nearly ) every previous GTA game. Later on, when GTA 6 lets you free-roam around as Lucia, she, too, has the same police scanner app installed on her phone. The game doesn’t show Cal installing it, so I’ll just assume it happened off-camera. Now, to be clear, I don’t think Rockstar needed to dedicate any time or effort to explaining how players could hear police radio chatter in GTA. Sure, sometimes I’d think about how it was possible for characters like CJ or Tommy Vercetti to hear the police reporting on their crimes, but then I would just remind myself it’s a video game, and games are filled with stuff that doesn’t make sense. Characters die and then respawn. Protagonists never age. And you can hear the police radio chatter despite not having a scanner. Just usual video game-y nonsense. Still, I think it’s fun that for GTA 6 , Rockstar took the time to explain how Jason and Lucia can hear the police radio chatter. And it also factors into gameplay. Our protagonists know if the police have spotted their car or have reported their clothing. They even mention it during chases as they try to make their escape, so it’s important we understand that the characters, and not just the player, can hear the chatter. In past games, you could just assume it was a gameplay mechanic, and the protagonists didn’t hear the radio messages. Not so in GTA 6 . I guess Rockstar felt like it was finally necessary to provide a grounded explanation for this classic GTA feature.Â I await Rockstar explaining why every state in the GTA universe is an island in Grand Theft Auto 7. sources.title: Yes, You Can Keep Playing GTA 6 After The Credits Roll And Don’t Worry, That’s Not A Spoiler
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a very, very big game with tons of main missions, side missions, activities, random events, races, and more to find and complete. So you might feel compelled to clear out the map before reaching the finale. But you don’t need to do that. In past Rockstar Games, like GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 , the studio has let players return to the open world after finishing the main story. However, how this has been handled has varied. In RDR2 , you take on the role of another character who can complete activities and side missions after the credits roll. In GTA IV, the game just lets you keep playing post-credits as Niko. This is how it works in most GTA games, actually. Things are a bit different in GTA 6. Instead, before you enter the final mission, which took me about 90 hours or so to reach in my playthrough, the game makes a big point of asking if you want to go forward with the finale or not. Once you wrap up that big, multi-mission finale and see one of the game’s main endings, GTA 6 tosses you back in time to that moment when you were asked if you wanted to finish the story or not. But this time, Jason and Lucia say no; they aren’t ready, and head back out into Vice City. At that point, you can keep playing GTA 6 , wrap up everything on the map, and explore. (The finale mission marker remains on the map if you want to finish the game again and possibly get a different ending.) It’s an interesting way to handle the endgame and is unlike any past Grand Theft Auto . It also lets G TA 6 ‘s ending go in a lot of different directions, depending on your choices. I’m not going to even hint at what those endings are, but I’ve seen two of them and trust me, they play out in wildly different and sometimes surprising ways. The one downside to this approach is that GTA 6 feels a bit frozen in time at the end of the game. No new major storylines can be introduced, as they would possibly get in the way of the narrative wrapping up. But hey, once you beat the final mission, you unlock the ability to reach 100 percent completion and even unlock the ability to complete challenges to reveal in-game cheat codes that let you go wild in Vice City. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has the longest story ever seen in a GTA game, which also means that it has an enormous cast of characters. Between rival faction leaders, radio station DJs, and fictional rappers, you're going to meet a whole lot of people in Leonida. And some of their voices might sound very familiar. While the full cast list is so large that it takes up a good chunk of GTA 6 's hour-plus end credits, these are some of the biggest players in the story, including Jason and Lucia. Some you might recognize from movies or even previous Rockstar games, while others have some modest TV credits to their name. Below, we've listed all the actors who play main roles in GTA 6 , along with their previous work that they've starred in. Much of GTA 6 's cast comes from a TV background, and that includes Jason Duval. His voice actor, Dylan Rourke, has appeared on shows like 9-1-1: Lone Star , Station 19 , and Grey's Anatomy . GTA 6 is his most high-profile role by a mile, though, unless you count his gig as ”Big Guy” on Modern Family as a star turn. Manni L. Perez, the actress behind Lucia Caminos, comes from a similar acting background as Dylan Rourke. Perez has popped up in Law & Order: Special Victims Unit , Chicago P.D. , and The Blacklist . She's also a Rockstar alumni; Perez voices a Clubber in Grand Theft Auto 5 , and a Blackjack Dealer in GTA Online . Jason and Lucia's comedic sidekick is one of the biggest stars in the entire cast. He's voiced by Bobby Moynihan, who was a principal cast member of Saturday Night Live from 2008 to 2017. You may remember him as playing Drunk Uncle, a recurring character on Weekend Update that already felt like a GTA bit. Moynihan has a long credits list outside of that, most recently appearing in NCIS: Origins , The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins , and Minions & Monsters . The worst kept secret in all of gaming, Stephen Root plays Brian Heder, Jason's employer. He needs little introduction. Root is the man behind Milton in Office Space , Monroe Fuches in Barry , and Bill in King of the Hill , to name a few of his roles. Funny enough, Root is also credited as Florida Man on the TV series It's Florida, Man . Fitting, no? A standout in the cast, Dre'Quan plays a major supporting role in GTA 6 once the story gets to Vice City. He's played by Naiqui Macabroad, an actor who has appeared on Law & Order , Chicago P.D. , and Crashing . sources.title: How to Get Ready for November 19
sources.text: November 19, 2026, has long been circled on your calendar. Birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays have come and gone, but this day belongs to you and your XBOX console. We can hardly believe it’s almost here, either. Once midnight strikes, you want to be locked in the action, so to help you prepare, we created a checklist to ensure distractions are put to bed so you can settle in for a season of gaming like nothing you’ve ever experienced before. 2026 has been full of some absolute bangers: Gears of War E-Day, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Forza Horizon 6, Halo: Campaign Evolved, Minecraft Dungeons II, Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred , Control Resonant , Mixtape , Pragmata , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Star Wars: Galactic Racer , 007 First Light , Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve … seriously, all these games came out this year . That also means you might have a hard drive that is nearing capacity. And you will be faced with some hard choices to free up approximately 212GB of space on your XBOX Series X|S before November 19. You could always upgrade the capacity of your console to keep all your games at the ready, using the storage expansion slot on the back of the console. Otherwise, you’ll have a hard choice to make which we do not envy. But know that you’re in good company – we had to find a way to make room too. XBOX Cloud Gaming means that you don’t need to own an XBOX Series X|S console to experience the latest games (or use up that hard drive space) – you can stream directly from the cloud to your XBOX One console. Game Pass subscribers receive an allotment of hours per month as part of their plans, but you can also purchase blocks of time . Certain upcoming major releases have been confirmed as cloud-ready on day one , so even if you don’t own a current gen console, your latest obsession isn’t out of reach. You never want to settle in for a long gaming session only to immediately get hit with an update download. If you haven’t used your XBOX Series X|S or XBOX One in a minute, be sure to power up and connect to the internet beforehand and make sure you’re all set with the latest system updates. You can also install any upcoming releases you may have pre-ordered, while you’re at it. If you’re feeling a gaming flu coming on (and there’s a lot of that going around right now), then take a sick day, rather than risk infecting your coworkers or classmates. Sometimes you just need to listen to your body’s needs, relax, and let the fever run its course. Miami’s own DJ Khaled, aka Dr. XBOX will write you a personalized note to help explain the situation. If this thing is really serious, you may even need the whole week to recover – it’s the responsible thing to do. We all have responsibilities. Some of them come with four legs and a suspect bladder. Don’t let Rufus ruin your gaming fun. Get ahold of a local dog walker to take them outside so you can enjoy the big day uninterrupted. Or drop them off at doggie daycare for a day (or week) to get them out of your hair. Is your XBOX in an area of the house that is easily accessible to younger players? Consider the steps you need to take to get it out of younger sightlines, like running an extension cable out to the shed in the backyard or huddling up in your at-home office. Even if you do find yourself bouncing between rooms, your save files reside in the Cloud, allowing you to pick up your session wherever you last plugged your console in. We’re always on the hunt for new tunes and one of the things we’re most looking forward to on November 19 is discovering a whole bunch of new tracks that are sure to make our listening playlist pop throughout the year. You can get started here on Spotify . XBOX Design Lab lets you create your own next-gen XBOX Wireless Controller. Choose from a combination of colors, patterns, textured grips, and more. You could even pick up some specially themed versions of controllers styled in hot pink and pastels – this one is particularly striking . Speaking of controllers, if you expect long gaming sessions in your near future, make sure that it’s plugged in so it has a full charge when you need it, or stock up on AA batteries. Maybe even get a backup controller ready so you can hot-swap them in and minimize interruptions. Looking for something to add to your queue? Check out the 1967 classic, “Bonnie and Clyde,” featuring Warren Beatty and Faye Dunaway to get you in the mood for an epic story about two tragic lovers who fall into a life of crime. We’ll have to wait and see if the outcome is any different this time around starting on November 19.

sources.text: The Wanted Level goes up to six now, but it isn't for the faint of heart In the entirety of my time playing the game for review , I was only able to reach a six-star Wanted level in GTA 6 the one time. That's partially because I was hell bent on maintaining a 'Professional' Criminal Profile in GTA 6 , and also because it's really difficult to activate. You have to really be on a bit of a mad one to get this level of heat coming down on you. If you aren't aware, GTA 6 brought back six stars to the Wanted system. You typically gain heat for doing everything from trespassing to petty crime to big bank robberies, with different numbers of stars indicating the volume of cops (and eventually military) who respond to try and bring you in. My only six-star encounter in GTA 6 was the result of a firefight with a regular citizen that went awry, the accidental throwing of a grenade at a bunch of cop cars, and then a high-speed pursuit which lasted for well-over 15 minutes and eventually resulted in me hijacking an aeroplane in a desperate attempt to gain some ground. As it turns out, it's only mass destruction and loss of life which will get you six-stars of trouble in GTA 6 . The problem with getting a 6-star wanted level in GTA 6 is that there's actually no way to resolve it. Once you've got that sort of heat on you, the cops and the military will not stop in their pursuit of you . My poor aeroplane lasted just minutes after jets were dispatched to bring me crashing down to Earth. Interestingly enough, there is a GTA 6 cheat code to raise the wanted level, but no matter how many times I put in the activation code, it would never go above five stars. Which is all to say, the game really is only giving you a 6 star wanted level in GTA 6 when you really deserve it. And then once you've got it… settle in for some pretty outrageous carnage. sources.title: GTA 6 romance guide: How Jason and Lucia's relationship actually works
sources.text: Is the outlaw couple hot together? Or are they running on empty? In GTA 6 you've got a partner in crime, and it's quite a bit different than it was when you were pulling heists with Michael, Franklin, and Trevor in the last game. Jason and Lucia aren't just criminal associates, they're a couple, and their romantic relationship is a big part of the story. Jason and Lucia can grow closer or more distant, depending on your actions, behavior, and choices. That goes for everything from story missions to random criminal acts to everyday interactions and activities. Here's how Jason and Lucia's romance works in GTA 6 . There are four levels to Jason and Lucia's relationship that can change depending on how you play and the choices you make, one being the lowest and four being the highest. Here are the levels: When you begin playing as a couple in Chapter 1, your relationship is already a strong one, though it'll still take a while to get it up to 4/4, if that's your goal. Certain actions, activities, and choices will raise your relationship score, and you'll know you've done it when you hear a chime and see a +♥️ appear on the right side of your screen. Here are just a few actions that will add a ♥️ to your score, and there are plenty more: *Note: You can't initiate sex whenever you want, but there are multiple times in GTA 6 when a sex scene is available to you, signified by double hearts over your home icon on the map or with certain limited-time onscreen prompts. What leads to a sex scene? In my playthrough, twice these scenes happened while I was showering as one of the characters and the other asked if they could join me (and you can decide to let them or not). Another was after I reached a major milestone by contributing money to our savings account (hey, financial security is a major turn-on in real life, too!) and there was also a sex scene after a sizable heist. All of these happened while I was at a 4/4 "Hot Together" relationship status. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. You can also lose hearts from your relationship. This didn't happen often in my playthrough, but here's the ones I experienced: According to Rockstar, if you want a strong relationship in GTA 6, you have to play both sides of that relationship. That means not just playing as Jason and doing nice things for Lucia, but also playing as Lucia and treating Jason well. For my playthrough, where I reached the end of the game with a 4/4 "Hot Together" status, my stats show that I played nearly the exact same amount of time as Jason as I did Lucia. Don't worry, this couple isn't joined at the hip. Both Lucia and Jason have missions, storylines, and activities they can (and are sometimes required to) complete alone. You can play plenty of GTA 6 as just a single character running around without the other, just remember to occasionally spend some time with your partner, respond to their texts, and switch to the other character from time to time. But trust me, you'll want to spend lots of time together. Their relationship is fun to take part in, from both sides. Plus, doing crimes as a couple really pays off. It's helpful to have an extra set of hands to point guns at people, do crowd control during robberies, shoot out a cop's tires while driving, and carry off more loot than you could handle if you were rolling solo. I'll be honest: I don't know how the game is different if you have a 4/4 relationship or a 1/4 relationship, because I've only played through the story once at this point, and I kept my relationship as strong as possible for nearly the entire game. We'll know more about the effects of a weak relationship as other players experiment with their relationship status, and we'll update this guide with what we find out. sources.title: GTA 6 Personal Vehicles explained: How to own more vehicles
sources.text: Keeping track of your favorite cars in GTA 6 is one of the most important things that you need to learn how to do With over 157 cars and 29 types of bikes available throughout Leonida, understanding how vehicle ownership works in GTA 6 is crucial. Managing the Personal Vehicles of Jason and Lucia is a major priority as they'll be your main mode of transportation around the world. GTA 6 also handles unowned vehicles, destroyed vehicles, and impounded vehicles in slightly different ways, and the same goes for storing any of your favorites too. So for all things Personal Vehicle-related this car ownership guide will get you up to speed quickly on how vehicles work in GTA 6. A Personal Vehicle in GTA 6 is the car you are legally registered to ride. Both Jason and Lucia can have their own personal vehicle to call their own, but first they need to be registered (which can be costly, depending on the make and model of the car or bike). The benefit of investing in a personal vehicle in GTA 6 is that they can always be recovered via the ScooterBros app on your phone if they are lost or destroyed. You're also able to manage your loadout in GTA 6 from the trunk of these vehicles, change your outfit to lower Appearance heat, and store key items such as stash bags and any spoils from hunting trips. Helpfully, the location of your personal vehicle is always marked on the map. Just open up the GTA 6 Index and scroll to the Personal tab, which is where you'll find your car. Businesses such as Pay 'n' Sprays (as well as key contacts, once you've unlocked the relevant GTA 6 mission) will register an unowned vehicle as your personal vehicle for a fee. This can be pretty costly, depending on the make and model of the vehicle – and you won't be able to register a vehicle with a standard or advanced tracker until you've progressed far enough in the story. Locate a local Pay 'n' Spray by heading to the Vehicles section of the map index, and drive the vehicle you want to register over there. Once you're inside, you'll see the option to register the vehicle and the associated cost. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more It's worth noting that while Jason and Lucia can each have their own personal vehicle at any one time, you can register additional cars and bikes in their names once you purchase new garages. So long as you have the space to store them, you can register the vehicle – and you can summon any registered vehicle whenever you want via the ScooterBros app, a service which will deliver the owned car you want and return the one you don't to storage for a fee. So long as you have the necessary equipment, you can steal pretty much any car that you want to. The last unowned vehicle you drop will be marked on the map under the Personal section of the map index, but unlike Personal Vehicles they can't be recovered if they get destroyed. So, how do you keep an unowned vehicle safe? Beyond paying the price to register it as a personal vehicle, you have two ways to keep an unowned vehicle around. The first is to set it down in a parking space outside of your safehouse, if available. The other is to store it safely in a garage. If your vehicle takes enough damage (and you can't find somewhere to repair your car in GTA ) then it will eventually become undriveable. If this happens to your Personal Vehicle, it can be recovered via the ScooterBros app for a fee. If this happens to an Unowned Vehicle, not only will it be permanently destroyed but you'll also lose access to anything that was stored in its trunk. Sometimes the smartest way to lose your Wanted Level in GTA 6 is to dump your vehicle. This will clear your Vehicle Heat and give you a better chance of escaping, but it will most likely result in the cops impounding it. sources.title: GTA 6 Uses FSR 4.1 on Xbox Series S to Upscale From 720p to 1080p
sources.text: GTA 6 is finally here, and it's genuinely a technical marvel on all of the consoles it's running on. It's particularly impressive that the Xbox Series S can even run the thing, and now we know a bit more about how Rockstar was able to pull it off. Rather than rendering the game at the console's native 1440p, Rockstar used AMD's FSR 4.1 to upscale from 720p to 1080p, according to an interview with Wccftech . That would make GTA 6 one of the first games to use the new upscaling tech on Xbox, and it's probably what made the game possible on the budget console. I've already spent a bit of time with the Xbox Series S version of GTA 6, and while it does look a bit rough around the edges (literally), it looks better than I was expecting. Objects in the game are still incredibly detailed, but the edges of some objects – particularly distant buildings and hair – have a noticeable sheen of aliasing around them. But that lower resolution rendering is what lets the game mostly sit at around 30fps (though I did notice a couple drops down to the mid-20s.) According to the interview, the Xbox Series S is the only version of the game that's running on FSR 4. Both the Xbox Series X and base PS5 versions of the game are instead using Rockstar's in-house TAA (temporal anti-aliasing) solution, and the PS5 Pro is using PSSR 2.0. It shouldn't be surprising either, that the Xbox Series S is also running at the lowest input resolution out of all of the consoles at 720p, compared to 1440p on all of the other consoles. When Wccftech asked Rockstar about the reasons it picked each upscaling solution, it said: "Part of that process [of targeting 30fps] was determining our base resolution and upscaling solution. We evaluated a variety of approaches for each console, then selected a combination of each that gave us the look and performance we needed." And, well, despite some noisy surfaces and aliasing, FSR 4 absolutely let Rockstar hit that 30fps target on the Xbox Series S. Either way, GTA 6 is clearly a massive success. It's already the best-reviewed game of all time on Metacritic, and here at IGN we gave it a 10, with reviewer Luke Reilly saying: "exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played." We're also live blogging GTA 6's launch , in what is surely going to be the biggest release in gaming history. Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. sources.title: The Xbox Series S version of GTA 6 is seemingly the first to use AMD’s FSR 4.1 upscaling
sources.text: It was announced last month that the new tech was coming to Xbox Series X/S consoles The Xbox Series S version of Grand Theft Auto 6 appears to be the first game on the console to make use of AMD’s FSR 4.1 upscaling. Last month it was announced that Xbox Series X/S consoles and Xbox ROG Ally X handhelds were set to receive AMDâs latest upscaling tech in an upcoming update. FSR 4.1 is AMDâs equivalent of Nvidia âs DLSS technology, which uses machine learning to upscale game visuals, generate frames and improve ray tracing. As with DLSS, the main benefit of FSR 4.1 is that developers can theoretically render games at a lower resolution and use FSR to upscale them to 4K in a way that looks very close to native rendering. This can result in a performance boost which may make it easier for games to hit higher frame rates with minimal impact on visual fidelity. Now Rockstar has confirmed that the Xbox Series S version of the game makes use of FSR, to help the game reach its target resolution and frame rate while still retaining processor-heavy features like ray tracing and hair strands. In a joint statement provided to Wccftech , Rockstar’s senior vice president of technology Jonathon Ashcroft, technical director Chris Oat and technology production director Marc Chambers explained the processes used for each version of the game. “It became clear early on that given the scale of the teamâs ambition, weâd be targeting 30fps on this generation of hardware,” the statement read. “Weâve put a lot of effort into balancing presentation, simulation, and gameplay, as well as ensuring the input latency is vastly improved versus Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2 . “Part of that process was determining our base resolution and upscaling solution. We evaluated a variety of approaches for each console, then selected a combination of each that gave us the look and performance we needed. “On the PlayStation 5 and the Xbox Series X, weâre upscaling a base resolution of 1440p to 4K using our in-house TAA solution. On the Xbox Series S, weâre starting from a base resolution of 720p, which is scaled to 1080p using AMD FSR Upscaling 4. On PlayStation5 Pro, weâre taking advantage of PSSR2 to upscale from a base resolution of 1440p to 4K.” The confirmation that the Xbox Series S version uses AMD FSR suggests it may be the first Xbox Series S game to use the newly added upscaling tech. This would also explain Digital Foundry’s recent analysis of the Series S version, which expressed surprise that processor-intensive techniques like ray tracing are in there, and that it “genuinely looks quite close in broad strokes to Series X”. “Series S is still very recognizably GTA 6, and the compromises here donât amount to that much relative to the visual settings compromises we often find in AAA titles on Series S,” Digital Foundry’s video claimed. The publication stated that they admired Rockstarâs work on the Xbox Series S version because âtheyâve taken their massive, incredibly impressive 30fps PS5 and Series X game and translated it to much weaker hardware, hardware that game developers with much less substantial titles have struggled to work withâ. Despite this, the Series S version still struggles to maintain a consistent 30fps frame rate, and they concluded: âTheyâve made a Series S version that is relatively true to their vision with all the key tech represented in reasonable form. But frame rates on Series S arenât in a good place, and Iâd advise players to play the game on other console platforms for now.”
